summary.caption: A centered, near-symmetrical epic fantasy vista at dawn, shot from a low worm's-eye vantage on a 21mm wide-angle lens: a monumental luminous world-tree and white marble citadel rise dead center and nearly fill the frame, their vertical spires converging dramatically toward the top edge. A long stone causeway with tiny cloaked pilgrims begins at the bottom edge and leads the eye straight to the citadel gate in strong one-point perspective. A hidden sun behind the canopy backlights everything: volumetric light shafts spill through the branches, rim-lighting every spire and leaf, while drifting mist separates the depth planes. Cool teal shadows against pale gold highlights, restrained cinematic grading, deep focus f/16, fine film grain, gentle vignette, overwhelming monumental scale. Balanced but not flat: floating islands and cascading waterfalls frame both sides, layered cloud sea and distant peaks recede into violet-blue aerial perspective. No text, no watermark, no logos.

items.label: object
items.caption: Dead center, filling almost the full frame height: a colossal ancient world-tree with luminous turquoise foliage, its exposed roots cradling a terraced white-marble citadel of tall slender spires and glowing rune bridges. Strong backlight produces a brilliant rim along every edge; the canopy breaks the top of the frame, conveying overwhelming scale. Symmetrical but organically detailed, crisp architectural rendering.

items.label: object
items.caption: Bottom center foreground: a long narrow stone causeway with weathered arches receding toward the citadel gate in strict one-point perspective, its converging lines forming a powerful leading line. Two minuscule cloaked pilgrims with staffs walk along it, tiny against the architecture. Dark warm stone in the near field, gradually veiled by low mist toward the far end.

items.label: object
items.caption: Upper left: a floating island with a slender ruined tower and a thin waterfall dissolving into cloud, cool blue low-contrast aerial perspective, framing the central mass without competing with it.

items.label: object
items.caption: Upper right: a matching floating island with cascading waterfalls and layered snow peaks behind, pale violet-blue haze, mirroring the left side to hold the symmetry.

items.label: object
items.caption: Several tiny long-winged dragons gliding high across the canopy, backlit dark silhouettes with warm edge glow, deliberately small to reinforce the monumental scale.

items.label: object
items.caption: A soft hidden sun disc directly behind the tree canopy, its light bursting through the leaves as volumetric shafts, the brightest point of the frame with gentle golden bloom.
